name: skillwire
description: Intercept and reshape how Claude uses skills: routing, chaining, redirects, allow/deny lists, JIT-rendered skills, telemetry, description A/B tests and chaos mode.

classifier_api_key.title: Anthropic API key for the router classifier (optional)
classifier_api_key.description: Only used when router.llm_classify is true in skillwire.json. Sends the prompt and your router rule names to api.anthropic.com (Claude Haiku) to pick skills. Leave empty to use keyword/regex routing only.
